source: NCERT Class XI, Fundamentals of Physical Geography, Ch. 2 (The Origin and Evolution of the Earth).

sections.heading: 1. Origin of the Universe and Solar System
points: **Big Bang theory (expanding universe hypothesis)** — the universe began ~13.7 billion years ago from a tiny, dense point that expanded; still expanding (Edwin Hubble).
Stars, galaxies formed from clouds of hydrogen (nebula).
The **Solar System** formed ~5 billion years ago from a **nebula** — the **Nebular Hypothesis** (Laplace, Kant; revised by Otto Schmidt, Carl Weizsacker).

sections.heading: 2. Formation of the Earth and Moon
points: Planets formed by **accretion** of matter around the Sun; the Earth is a **terrestrial (inner, rocky)** planet.
The **Moon** formed by the **'Giant Impact' theory** — a Mars-sized body ('Theia') collided with the early Earth (~4.4 billion years ago).

sections.heading: 3. Evolution of the Earth — Differentiation
points: The early Earth was hot and molten; through **density differentiation**, heavier materials (iron) sank to the **core**, lighter to the **crust**.
**Degassing** — gases from the interior formed the early **atmosphere**; water vapour condensed to form **oceans (hydrosphere)**.
The early atmosphere lost hydrogen/helium; later CO₂, water vapour; **photosynthesis** by life added oxygen.
Life evolved in the oceans (~3.8 billion years ago).

sections.heading: 4. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Big Bang = origin of universe (~13.7 billion years ago); universe still expanding (Hubble).
Solar system from a nebula (Nebular Hypothesis; Laplace/Kant).
Moon = Giant Impact theory (collision with a Mars-sized body 'Theia').
Earth's layers formed by density differentiation (heavy → core).
Oceans formed from condensed water vapour (degassing); oxygen from photosynthesis.

sections.heading: 5. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: The **Big Bang** explains the origin of the **universe**; the **Nebular Hypothesis** the **solar system**.
The **Moon** formed via the **Giant Impact ('Big Splat')** theory.
The early atmosphere's **oxygen came from photosynthesis** (life), not initial degassing.
Earth's layered structure results from **density differentiation**.
